tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground: Settings window, welcome backdrop, the area behind cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one content pane (o-pane), the selected sidebar pill on the wash, large keycaps. The default ground for body text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menus, submenus, tooltips, coach marks, HUD (under glass).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: secondary buttons, keycaps, segmented track, switch track off, slider bar track, progress track.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Neutral highlight for a hovered row, sidebar item or ghost button.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separators between rows and menu groups, and the 1px ring inside shadow-popover and shadow-float. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control, never a box around content.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls (switch track off, inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and symbols on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, hover and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, group labels, shortcut hints, footnotes. On bg, surface, surface-raised and hover.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary metadata. Meets 4.5:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken; disabled items use it at 60% opacity.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The palette's brand fill: primary button, switch on, selected segment, progress, current workspace pill.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: accent while hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as text or a meaningful symbol: links, the Symbol showcase. On surface, surface-raised, accent-soft and wash-1. Never for hover or keyboard highlight.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Info callouts only. Holds ink and accent-ink. Never a hover or keyboard highlight: those use hover.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The palette's quiet tone: illustration fills, layout-thumbnail panes, empty states.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states: tour step passed, permission granted. Always paired with checkmark.circle.fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Window refuses to resize, config warnings. Always paired with exclamationmark.triangle.fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive menu items (Quit, Reset), errors. Always a word plus a symbol, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for a highlighted destructive row and error callouts. Holds danger and ink.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for floating chrome when real Liquid Glass is unavailable (web, pre-macOS 26).

tokens.name: wash-1
tokens.usage: Zen-style chrome wash, first stop (top-left): accent mixed into bg. Window chrome and sidebars sit on the wash; ink, ink-muted and accent-ink read on it.

tokens.name: wash-2
tokens.usage: Chrome wash, second stop (bottom-right): tint mixed into bg. Use as linear-gradient(140deg, wash-1, bg 55%, wash-2).

tokens.name: swatch-ouch-blue
tokens.usage: Logo source: the main window's electric blue (gradient #8dc3ff to #0a74ff). Ouch accent, deepened to #0a68e6 in light for white text.

tokens.name: swatch-ouch-sky
tokens.usage: Logo source: top of the blue gradient. Ouch dark accent-ink and focus.

tokens.name: swatch-ouch-graphite
tokens.usage: Logo source: icon ground (gradient #4a4a4f to #1b1b1e). Ouch dark bg.

tokens.name: swatch-ouch-paper
tokens.usage: Logo source: the white windows (#fdfdfd to #e6e6eb). Ouch light sunken surfaces.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome card title, cover, showcase headlines. Light, never bold; one per screen.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Step numbers in flows and showcase eyebrows, in ink-muted.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Move focus with H J K L
styles.usage: Tour-card titles, Settings pane titles, HUD layout name. Emphasise one word at 500, never more.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings inside a pane and tip titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Main on the left, the rest stacked on the right
styles.usage: Menu items, settings row labels, tour-card body, tips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row descriptions, footnotes, breadcrumbs. Single line; truncate, don't wrap.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group titles and menu group labels, in ink-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Step counters on tour cards; the only uppercase.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Inset between the menu panel padding and its rows (space-1 + space-0-5 = 6px menu padding).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label inside a pill; tip padding; gap below a group title.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Menu row horizontal padding, symbol-to-label gap, gap between keycaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's symbol, text and control; toast vertical padding; gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toast horizontal padding, tour-card bottom padding, gap between stacked groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tour-card padding, Settings pane padding, space above surface actions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; HUD horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Welcome card padding, hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small keycaps, the menu bar icon highlight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, layout picker cells, the slider value bubble: anything inset inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tooltips (Surface xs), large tour keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, submenus, tips and toasts (Surface sm and md). Concentric with the rows inside: radius-lg 12 = radius-sm 6 + 6px menu padding.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Tour cards (Surface lg). Fixed exceptions: sidebar items 10px, the content pane 14px, the HUD 22px, the welcome card 24px.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, segmented controls and thumbs, workspace pills, sliders, progress, the HUD warning pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Keycaps and the switch thumb: a 1px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, submenus, tooltips, command menu.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Coach marks, HUD, welcome card: things that float over other apps.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Menu and command rows.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons (sm 26px, lg 36px), icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-kbd
tokens.usage: Small keycap height in hints, tooltips and labels; tour-card keycaps are 40px.

tokens.name: size-menu
tokens.usage: Menu-bar menu width; submenus 232px; the command menu 360px.
